brandKit.rationale: Civic housing-finance tone with deep green, climate blue, pale avocado, and restrained orange. Matches the educational, compliance-aware MLI Select page better than generic SaaS or decorative finance styling.

productionRules.rasterAssetPolicy: Only standalone generated visual subjects belong in this package. Do not use screenshots, table crops, checklist crops, UI mockups, or text-heavy images as page assets.
productionRules.format: Transparent WebP, quality 90, method 6, alpha validated after optimization.
productionRules.sourcePolicy: Generation sources and transparent PNG intermediates were used for the pipeline, but are intentionally not kept in public/ so deployable assets stay lean.
